newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian shares tumbles further, more falls expected.
newsitem.headline: Belgian shares tumbles further, more falls expected.

text.p: 1540 GMT - Brussels bourse fell further on Wednesday as investors continued to take profits on worries that inflation in the U.S. could lead to an interest rate hike.
* Bel-20 closed down 0.31 percent at 2,132.12, its third drop in as many days.
* Main loser, insurer Royale Belge down 2.14 percent to 8,700 francs on profit-taking after recent gains.
* Retailer Delhaize down 1.27 percent to 1,945 francs, with largest volume traded as investors took profits.
* Investors nervously awaiting U.S. interest rate decision due March 25 by U.S. Federal Open Market Committee.
